operational_definition: A functional capability counts as system-level in this lab when the causally coupled whole exceeds every isolated component and an equal-component nonadaptive control, degrades when connections are scrambled without removing parts, and exhibits context-specific losses under targeted component lesions.
claim_boundary: Passing the criteria supports a narrow claim of functional systemic synergy and causal organizational dependence in this synthetic benchmark. It does not establish phenomenal consciousness, biological equivalence, open-ended emergence, or Unity transfer.
